faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about ZAFrimo.
faq.a1: From the welcome screen, choose to sign up, enter your details and confirm your e-mail with the 6-digit code we send you. You can sign up as a visitor or as an owner/professional.
faq.q2: I forgot my password: what do I do?
faq.a2: On the login screen, choose the forgotten password link. We send you a 6-digit code by e-mail: enter it together with your new password.
faq.a3: To publish listings and news you need at least {stars} stars. Stars are given by the administrator based on trust criteria: your profile has a section explaining how to get them.
faq.a4: Stars show a member's level of trust and are visible on their profile and publications. They cannot be bought. To become a paid consultant you need at least {consultantStars} stars and the administrator's authorization.
faq.q5: Is my phone number visible to others?
faq.a5: No. Your number and e-mail are never shown: all contacts go through the app's messaging.
faq.q6: How do I block or report a user?
faq.a6: Open the user's conversation or profile and choose “Block user” or “Report user”. You can also report a listing or an article from its page. Blocked users are managed in the settings.
faq.q7: How does a paid consultation work?
faq.a7: Choose a consultant, check the price and pay in the app. When the payment is confirmed, a dedicated chat opens for {hours} h. Afterwards the conversation stays read-only.
faq.q8: How do I ask for a refund?
faq.a8: Contact support quoting the payment reference, which you can find in the payments section of your profile. The rules are described in the terms of sale.
